title: How Much Does a Heat Pump Cost? Between $8K and $23K - Here's Why
summary: Oklahoma City HVAC company explains why replacing or upgrading to a ducted heat pump spans a wide price range, with sizes, efficiency tiers and warranties.

verdicts.note: Capacity and efficiency tier drive equipment price, though installation complexity and contractor also move quotes.

Central heat pump cost was regressed on tons and HSPF, but for ductless units rated efficiency had no significant effect, swamped by existing equipment, electrical work, manufacturer and installer margins.

LBNL: ductless heat pump cost scaled near-linearly with capacity, but per-ton cost did not rise with HSPF or SEER and efficiency 'does not appear to be a strong driver of installed cost'; so size yes, efficiency tier no.
From manufacturer price feedback, the report finds much of the variation in heat pump cost is brand-related and also reflects regional supplier constraints, not mainly size or efficiency tier.
